title: 1 A fast-acting 5 × 20 mm fuse in an inline holder on a base

sources.citation: The 1 A fast-acting 5 × 20 mm glass cartridge fuse, a common supplemental-protection class listed to UL 248-14. Typical published figures for the class, paraphrased (not one vendor's): a cold resistance of about 0.1 Ω and a nominal melting I²t of a few tenths of an A²·s (0.7 A²·s is taken). For electrical-realism-reviewer to confirm against the class's datasheets.

game-design inside the published opening-time envelope of UL 248-14 supplemental fuses (paraphrased, not reproduced): the fuse carries its rating, opens within an hour at 135 % and within two minutes at 200 % of it. The fictional datasheet's own band, which the model is tested against: never at 100 %; within 1 h at 135 %; within 5 s at 200 %; between 1 ms and 20 ms at 1000 %. A minimum fusing current of 1.2 × the rating (between 1 and 1.35, as that envelope requires) is taken.
game-design: an inline fuse holder on a 70 × 30 mm base, 30 mm tall, with a screw terminal at each end; not modelled on a product. Replacing the fuse in P2 means deleting it and placing a new one.
